description.value: Xing Fu Tang is a Taiwanese bubble tea chain known for its hand-crafted brown sugar boba, with this Vancouver location situated in a basement-level unit on Dunsmuir Street downtown. The shop offers indoor seating for about 30 and specializes in freshly made bubble tea drinks with vegetarian-friendly options.
